semiconductor_relevance: High — ABM, Inc. specializes in lithography systems and process equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: ABM, Inc. is a global leader in lithography equipment manufacturing, providing essential support for front-end semiconductor processes. Their offerings include advanced lithography systems for integrated circuits, MEMS, and optical communications, along with comprehensive services in equipment R&D and process optimization.

regional_presence.China: ABM, Inc. is set to participate in SEMICON China 2026, indicating a strategic focus on the Chinese market.
